name: The First Milling Company
summary: The First Milling Company produces and sells flour products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides flour, bran, semolina, specialty flour, peeled and crushed wheat under First Mills and Aloula brand name. In addition, it offers complete crushed feed, livestock fattener, lamb, horse, pigeon, dairy cattle, poultry feed pellet under the Naffa'a brand name. The First Milling Company was founded in 1972 and is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
